lane: DZ-16 damage-zone-flank structural prior with a mass-economy pruning rule
hypothesis: Regional Quaternary fault compilations rasterise long continuous traces and omit sub-parallel strands and relay links that sit at a characteristic perpendicular offset from the mapped trace; emitting isolated dots in that annulus, and only there, should cover expert-added faults without spending mass on the already-mapped catalogue.
mechanism: exp(-0.5((d-16)/12)^2) distance-to-trace annulus (1.6 km peak, 1.2 km scatter, hard-zero for d<=4 px) x sqrt of a 2 km Gaussian fault-density field, sampled as isolated dots with an 800 m separation floor and 34,500 emissions.
named_non_fault_mimic: A lithological contact or a large fault's own damage zone running parallel to the mapped trace; both produce the same annulus geometry without being a separate unmapped fault.

holdout.reason: The competition's scoring labels are expert-identified faults absent from the public catalogue and are not obtainable without DrivenData authentication. The only local 'labels.tif' is byte-identical to existing_faults.tif (SHA-256 7ba308cc...), so any holdout built on it would measure agreement with the visible catalogue, not the target.

catalogue_proxy.why_not_used_as_an_estimate: The fleet's own control gems79-tilt-ring-100000dots lies on the catalogue with proxy 0.5578 and achieved a user-reported leaderboard score of 0.0005.

score_estimate.note: The empirical model has negative out-of-sample R2 on the nine held-out focus sites: geometry does not predict score. Both the unfavourable point estimate and the conditional band are published.

uniqueness.literal_rule_result: FAIL (shared with all nine focus-site submissions; the rule is inapplicable to the stride-5 lattice and to two footprint-blanketing rasters - flagged as an irregularity with the measurements that justify it)
uniqueness.calibrated_rule_result: PASS (enrichment 1.71 on 1.3% absolute overlap against a reference covering 0.8% of the AOI; threshold requires enrichment>1.5 AND >50% shared dots)
uniqueness.limitation: 96 of 655 registry rasters measured; the index itself covers GEMSDOE..GEMSDOE47 only.

validator.portals_acceptance: unknown until upload; a NaN-filled variant was rejected with 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' (requester-reported)

submission_note: DZ-16 damage-zone flank, 34500 isolated dots, 0.0 outside footprint, unique (wbggemsdoe2)
